notes.text: Available in cPanel 136 and later. Read-only account-wide WHM inventory lists each cPanel account's web log retention preference alongside the server-wide default from Tweak Settings. This is separate from the selected-account LogManager settings and does not modify settings.

default_retention and per-account retention_days are integer days; zero means logs are retained indefinitely. An explicit null account retention_days means the account uses the server default, while omission remains absent. using_default remains a native boolean, unlike UAPI LogManager integer flags. Account user/domain strings, optional fields and empty account lists are preserved.

The original 2026-10-31 WHM capture on cPanel 11.138.0.19 returned default_retention as a numeric string. Reviewer 5721279104 separately observed native integer custom account retention_days values 30 and 0, boolean using_default and restored default state after clearing an override on that version. These are single WHM-route observations.

Preserve optional fields, explicit null and empty account lists. Only default_retention accepts canonical signed decimal integer strings within PHP integer bounds and normalizes them to int; account fields stay strict. API success establishes inventory only and does not prove eventual retention enforcement.

evidence.note: Pinned /list_accounts_retention GET declares x-readonly=true with no parameters. Preserve the optional account fields, nullable integer retention_days and native boolean using_default exactly. WHM source SHA256 6edb13c51d53f3c2be1fa83cc93e31d3a81f4f8506b3b45284fa00b986041594. No role restriction or string-integer response variant is declared.
